notes.title: v1.08 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Update Notes
[list]
[*] Character Switch Panel: Added "Weakness" title display
[*] Fixed a bug where gamepad shortcut keys did not work properly in the pregame panel
[*] Fixed an issue where certain encounter card effects failed to trigger correctly
[*] Fixed an error that could occur when entering the police station
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.06
notes.notes: [p]Fixed an issue where drawing an Encounter card outside of the event phase could cause the screen to freeze[/p]

notes.title: version 1.04
notes.notes:
Update Notes

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where voice lines were always incorrect
[*] Fixed a bug where some buttons played sound effects twice
[*] Fixed a problem where closing the panel could cause step guidelines to overlap
[*] Fixed a bug where opening the bag would trigger multiple sound effects
[*] Switching languages no longer reloads the entire scene
[*] Improved core code structure for better overall performance and maintainability
[/list]

notes.title: version 1.03
notes.notes:
Update Notes
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where press actions could still trigger while dragging
[*] Slightly adjusted mission target values for all locations before they are unlocked
[*] Fixed a bug where character cards could sometimes point to the wrong ID
[*] Fixed a tutorial issue where incorrect character information was shown if the player didn’t choose the default character
[*] Added a Discord button
[/list]

notes.title: version 1.021
notes.notes:
Update Notes

[list]
[*] Slightly reduced the size of the button bag
[*] Adjusted the position of the ally/support max label
[*] Fixed an issue where the tutorial could freeze
[*] Fixed a bug where Mia Martinez’s action skill did not function correctly
[*] Fixed an issue allowing characters to use actions even with zero stamina
[*] Fixed a bug where, after using an equipment card, hand cards sometimes couldn’t be selected
[*] Fixed certain condition cards not working as intended
[*] Fixed an issue where the main character could still attack with zero stamina
[*] Fixed Sedative being usable even when the character was not in "used" mode
[*] Fixed incorrect trigger behavior for ally (interrupt) during event scenes
[*] Pop Panel: all buttons are now properly hidden when displayed
[/list]
